pairing.title: Pair a device
pairing.help: Pair a phone app such as meshenger by scanning a QR code: it gets its own device token with the scopes you choose, attached to your account, without anyone typing a token. A code works once and expires in a few minutes.
pairing.ingressNotice: You are signed in through Home Assistant. A device cannot pair through Home Assistant's ingress: it must reach Meshloom at its own address, which the QR code carries.
pairing.createHelp: Name the device, choose what it may do and how long the code stays valid. Meshloom then shows a QR code for the device to scan.
pairing.label: Device name
pairing.scopesHelp: Tick only what the device needs. The device never gets more than your role allows.
pairing.qrHelp: Open meshenger (or another app that enrols with Meshloom) on the device and scan this QR code. It is shown only now; Meshloom keeps a fingerprint of the code and cannot show it again.
pairing.secretWarning: This QR code is a password for a new device. Do not share it, do not post a screenshot of it, and scan it only with your own device. Anyone who scans it before it expires gets access to your account with these scopes.
pairing.qrAlt: QR code to pair a device with Meshloom
pairing.expired: This code has expired and the QR code is hidden. Create a new one.
